answer: Newcomers enter through an inlet with a sponsor locking a 150-credit bond on the reef. A sponsor vouches for at most four each epoch; a hollow sponsor with zero reputation cannot. A caught fake burns the bond and cuts 25 points; below 60 barred. A hollow-sponsor ring renting slots pays 200 each, so 1,000 fakes need 250 sponsors, 237,500 against a 40,000 pool. Honest newcomers need one sponsor once, bond back after a clean epoch.
